scope: Selected IC footprint: the western outer ramp now starts at the upper southbound highway and ends at a separate southern boundary. Excludes Galmae IC, the Sejong-Pocheon Expressway and roads upstream of the selected footprint. east_service_out is a separate local-direction boundary.

design_adjustments_2026_10_29.reason: User requested cleaner separation and allowed departure from exact IC geometry.
design_adjustments_2026_10_29.northbound_exit: 5-lane approach (4 through + 1 dedicated exit); 1-lane separated ramp expands to 3 after about 90m.
design_adjustments_2026_10_29.outer_exit: outer_join is now a curved independent sink at (95,-565); no connection to sb_out.
design_adjustments_2026_10_29.unchanged: Total demand, vehicle physics, bridge connectivity and skeleton interfaces.
design_adjustments_2026_10_29.outer_entry: Both exit ramps now originate at the same upper highway node sb_exit. Approach sb_in has four through lanes plus two exit lanes; lane 0 goes to outer_entry and lane 1 to south_exit. Purple vehicles start at sb_in, not at the ramp. The outer ramp remains an independent sink at its southern end. This is a user-requested simplified arrangement, not a surveyed lane count.
design_adjustments_2026_10_29.east_lane_cleanup: Only the tail of east_ramp, the alignment of east_join, and the head of east_service_out were adjusted to remove overlapping lane envelopes. Lane counts, routes and connections are unchanged. The joining lane keeps a separation of up to 4 m from the arterial that closes smoothly at east_merge.
design_adjustments_2026_10_29.west_lane_cleanup: Western eastbound approach east_in now has two through lanes plus one dedicated departure lane. Its center is shifted outward by half a lane to preserve the through alignment. return_ramp starts in line with the new outer lane and diverges gently. All routes, the remaining road edges, and the bridge level relationships are retained; this is a presentation-oriented simplification, not a surveyed lane count.
